frozen: 2026-11-24 evening, after Zach's refined spec (Daily Note Nov 24 ~l.2045-2116) and the coverage session's answer, before any of the five workbench variants was built. Supersedes criteria-shell-v1.json (the shell round it froze was redirected before scoring).

requirements.name: Runs are atomic: the rail filters runs, every tab follows
requirements.why: "Well really I would say we are just filtering the Runs. the runs are what are atomic here. The targets is just showing like what are the targets that remain after you filter the runs".
requirements.passCondition: Any rail pick (deployment, dataset, split, model type, config, sim/real, target, search) removes runs; Overview recounts; Targets lists only targets with a run left; the count says N of M runs.

anchors.1: Filters act on targets or per tab.
anchors.3: Runs filter, but a tab does not recount or the count is unclear.
anchors.5: Every tab recounts from the run filter; Targets = targets with runs left; count and pills on every tab.

requirements.name: Outer view to target view: two stages, linked
requirements.why: "two stages here which are good the outer one where we are looking across all targets and the target view where we are now looking at one specific target"; "I particularly like filtering by a particular target ... now it's a reasonable number of runs"; today's target view is the base.
requirements.passCondition: From the outer view one target's view (Lines panel with per-run checkboxes, repeats lines/bands, joint error + FB share charts) is ≤ 2 clicks; what the rail kept carries over; the way back is one click and keeps the filter.

anchors.1: No target view, or it loses the filter and the way back.
anchors.3: Reachable, but the filter does not carry or the way back resets it.
anchors.5: ≤ 2 clicks, filter carried into the checkboxes, back in one click with the filter intact.

requirements.name: Open in Rerun sends exactly the selected runs
requirements.why: "I want to have a button on the target view to open in rerun. Now any of the selected runs show now appear as lines in the rerun viewer. That allows us to basically like do any number of possible comparisons".
requirements.passCondition: The button says how many runs it sends; Rerun opens one recording with one line per selected run per joint (plus the target); what 'selected' means is visible.

anchors.1: Only one run at a time.
anchors.3: Sends a set, but which set is ambiguous or not counted.
anchors.5: Exactly the visible selection, counted on the button, proved N lines for N runs.

requirements.name: All deployments at the top; deployment a filter; model type across deployments
requirements.why: "you should at the top level also have all the deployments present. Filtering to just a single deployment is something you can filter for. If you use the same configuration across multiple deployments then you can compare it ... some grouping by model type across deployments".
requirements.passCondition: No split by deployment; deployment is a rail facet; the League can group by model type across deployments; comparing across deployments shows a warning, not a block.

anchors.3: All deployments, but no model-type grouping or no warning.
anchors.5: All present, model type grouping, an explained cross-deployment warning.

requirements.name: Compact, droppable, honest colour
requirements.why: "compact ... so it can drop into anything"; not "tabs at the top top"; headline numbers on the Overview only; one colour per dataset, explained.
requirements.passCondition: Tabs belong to the component; rail folds; headline numbers only on Overview; every colour has a legend saying what it is.

anchors.3: Component tabs but a colour or headline leaks.

requirements.name: Stock parts, short path to production
requirements.why: "we don't need to reinvent the wheel"; data-ui <data-workbench> is the stock pattern (CONTRACT §53); robot_msgs.viz.rerun is the stock Rerun look.
requirements.passCondition: Outer view is stock <data-workbench> + a .base; target view reuses traj_compare's; Rerun uses robot_msgs.viz.rerun; gaps named.

anchors.5: Stock end to end, small named gaps.

gates.name: Real bench data
gates.condition: All four bench deployments (UR5e cell, UR5e alone, BAM FB, pendulum) from their own traj_compare payloads; no invented numbers (a proposed model-type mapping is labelled as such).

gates.name: One local command, no CDN
gates.condition: Runs from serve_round.py (data-ui ships ES modules, which Chrome refuses over file://), no network.

gates.name: The pattern
gates.condition: Rail + Overview / Targets / Runs tabs; League table is the Overview; rail drags, width remembered, folds.

gates.name: Rerun
gates.condition: Open in Rerun from the target view sends the selected runs (the round's endpoint) and every row drills in.

gates.name: Clean
gates.condition: No console errors, no sideways scroll at 1440 x 900.
